why_local.text: Prompts, documents and answers never leave your network. That is a simpler guarantee than any contract a provider can offer, and it matters for the regulated data you hold.
You control the whole chain: the model, its exact version, the serving software and who can reach it. No outside service joins your attack surface.
No rate limits, no outages caused by someone else's demand, no surprise deprecations. A validated, pinned model behaves the same next month.

blockers.guidance: Use the simplest stack (Ollama + Open WebUI) and follow the numbered setup steps; no command line needed after install.

privacy.egress: Deny all outbound by default. Model downloads happen only in a separate `make pull` step.
privacy.encryption_at_rest: Full-disk encryption required (FileVault / LUKS / BitLocker); encrypted backups.
privacy.encryption_in_transit: TLS on the LAN via Caddy's local CA
privacy.remote_access: None by default; if needed, WireGuard/Tailscale only. Never port-forward.
privacy.acl_enforcement: Per-user and per-collection ACLs enforced in the database query (Postgres row-level security), not only in the UI.
privacy.compliance_note: Regulated data present. These controls support privacy obligations but do not by themselves make you compliant with HIPAA, PCI, GDPR or similar; review with your compliance advisor.

warnings: Assumption: Children's data present: Restricted tier enabled for kids' school/medical folders.

subscription.label: Flat-rate AI subscription (team plan, per user)

tco.verdict: On these estimates, a hosted open-weight model API would be cheaper than local by about $754 over three years. Local is recommended here for privacy, security, availability, not price. The saving has a privacy cost: every question, the chat history sent with it and the document passages Recall finds would go to the router and whichever provider it routes to. For this profile that is not just a preference: its regulated data makes it a compliance question.
assumptions: hosted APIs bill ~6,500 input tokens per question (2,000 question and instructions + 1,500 chat history resent + 3,000 Recall passages) and 500 output; the low figure counts the question only, at the cheapest provider
admin time at $0/hour (your own time is not priced); electricity $0.17/kWh
High-memory machines may hold resale value while memory prices are high; resale is not counted.
